scope: Sampled original Level2 components, not full sequence equivalence.
limits: All16 plans have source-identified clock and scale observations; motion has9 plans and reference placement15.
Bookends are unpaused observations, not proof of atomicity or interior ABA absence.
Stateful phase, configured rate and counters are the passing model; the legacy stateless phase is retained separately.
Reference placements use native role bindings and shooting side; animated physical roots are another basis.
Native launches and noncorresponding physical/reference heights remain outside the reference component.
Ball, hands, full poses, role selection, every tick, freeze/release/score correspondence and played cameras remain unproven.
Initial reports with three stateful clock mismatches, five producer-input timing mismatches and the physical/reference basis mistake remain retained.
